items.name: workspace
items.title: Folder setup
items.description: The build files a folder needs before mods can be added: bundles everything in src/mods/ into one file and puts it into the open drawing. Installed by tldraw-mods init.
items.docs: Build: npm run build. Put it into the open drawing: npm run apply. Add mods: npx tldraw-mods add <name>.

items.name: tool-chrome
items.title: Tool chrome
items.description: Shared code for mods that are boxes you type into: click-or-drag placement, an editing mode, and small controls that float around the edges. Landmark and Browser both use it.

items.name: landmark
items.title: Landmark
items.description: A named dashed outline you draw around a group of shapes. Its label stays the same size on screen as you zoom out, so you can find your way around a big drawing. Clicking inside it selects what is inside, not the outline.
items.docs: Added to src/mods/. If the drawing did not reload on its own, run: npm run apply

items.name: browser
items.title: Browser
items.description: A web page inside your drawing. Click to place it or drag to size it, type an address in the bar above it, and switch between phone, tablet, and desktop widths with the buttons on the right.
items.docs: Added to src/mods/. If the drawing did not reload on its own, run: npm run apply. Some sites refuse to be embedded and will show blank.

items.name: command-bar
items.title: Command bar
items.description: A shorter toolbar and a ⌘K search box. The toolbar keeps ten everyday buttons plus a More button; everything else, including tools from other mods, is a keystroke away. The search box also jumps to named landmarks on any page, flips editor preferences, and switches light and dark mode.
items.docs: Added to src/mods/. Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or the toolbar's last button. If the drawing did not reload on its own, run: npm run apply

items.name: toolbar-icons
items.title: Toolbar icons
items.description: Rendered 3D icons for the nine main toolbar buttons in place of the flat outlines. They grow slightly on hover and when active.
items.docs: Added to src/mods/. If the drawing did not reload on its own, run: npm run apply
